title: a listing moved to SHARED\LISTINGS while another system holds a program of its name forces no re-parse

checks.sql: SELECT r.library FROM copy_use c JOIN member m ON m.id=c.member_id JOIN member r ON r.id=c.resolved_member_id WHERE m.name='KVTPGM' AND m.kind='cobol' AND m.system='KVA' AND c.copybook='DUPREC'
